svg.title: Figure 1: Geodesic classification of cells in the {7,3} Poincaré disk
svg.desc: Cells within the inner angular half of each geodesic sector are colored cyan (on-geodesic); cells in the outer angular half are gray (off-geodesic). Seven geodesic directions are shown as dashed lines.
svg.text: dashed lines: 7 primary geodesic directions · 190-cell depth-4 grid
